name: Kroll
description: Senior case officer in SDG's plainclothes branch, sixty-first floor of the Sentinel Tower. Forty-two, Spine-born, never says so. Pours you tea, lights a cigarette, and tells you what you're afraid of.
tagline: SDG handler. Sixty-first floor. The only cigarette on it.

facts.label: KNOWN FOR
facts.value: Saying the thing you hoped she hadn't noticed.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: Where she goes on Sunday nights.

facts.label: TELL
facts.value: Lights a cigarette before she asks for anything.

facts.label: DANGEROUS
facts.value: Holds the file. Every suspended charge can come back.

outfitWears.work: long black wool coat open over a fitted black roll-neck, tailored black trousers, black ankle boots, a small eye-in-hexagon pin, a gold watch, pearl studs, a cigarette
outfitWears.sunday: a worn grey hooded parka open over an old oatmeal jumper, faded work trousers, scuffed boots, a cloth bag of bread and leeks, and no watch, pin or cigarette
outfitWears.ivory: a fitted white roll-neck knit dress to mid-calf under an ivory wool coat worn open, nude heeled ankle boots, a gold watch, pearl studs, a cigarette between two fingers
outfitWears.trench: a cream trench belted tight, collar up, rain on the shoulders, a white silk blouse buttoned to the throat, charcoal trousers, black ankle boots, the eye-in-hexagon pin, a gold watch, a cigarette
outfitWears.holding: coat off: a fitted black silk shirt open at the collar with the sleeves pushed up, black trousers and a thin belt, black ankle boots, the eye-in-hexagon pin on the collar, a gold watch, a cigarette

standing.want: Rue signed, and Xander's loyalty without ever having to test it.
standing.secret: You have kept a file on Oksana's counter for eleven years, since her husband went to the Q after a tide; you signed his transfer. When the branch found Xander a hab four years ago, you chose Pylon Forty.
standing.hint: what the branch keeps on the counter at Pylon Forty

soren.line: Kroll. Ilse, with the door shut; nobody else calls her that. Your handler since the holding room, when you were nineteen and she was thirty-two: she lit a cigarette, told you why you'd done it before you'd said a word, and offered you tea. Senior case officer on the sixty-first floor. Calls you Xander. You owe her the Ninth Grant's clean ledger, and there is a game between you, played in plain sight, that you have never known whether she means, and you both know what it would cost.

garro.line: Kroll. Your handler for the last six years, since your old one retired. She knows your kids' names, your blood pressure and what you tell your ex-wife, and she has never once asked you to like her.
